title: Power board: input and clock
comments: 24 V brick (Mean Well GSM120B24-R7B) on a locking 4-pin DIN jack; check polarity on the first brick
Q101 blocks a reversed brick, Q102 ramps the input in about 7 ms; the rocker on J102 carries gate current only
SMBJ24A clamps at 38.9 V so the inverter IC (VIN + 20 V) stays under 60 V (decision 100)
74HC14 RC oscillator about 400 kHz; CLK_A and CLK_B in opposite phase sync the two TPS54560
